args.question: Which monitor model did the design team standardise on for the new design hires? The catalog has two new (non-refurbished) options: MN-27 (27" 4K, $329 each) and MN-32 (32" 5K, $529 each). I need the model before I can place the single order (3× DK-200 docks + 3× monitors, shipped to HQ).
